name: Photo filter preset
summary: A saved set of colour and tone changes that a user applies to a photo with one tap.
how: Save the curve, fade, tint, vignette and grain values as one named set.
Apply the set to a photo at a strength from 0% to 100%.
Show the set as a thumbnail with a short name.
Keep one set for all photos when a feed must match.

origin.note: The Hipstamatic phone app applies lens and film looks to a photo with one tap.

adoptions.via: Instagram adds named filters such as Valencia and X-Pro II to square phone photos.
VSCO sells film-stock presets with short codes such as A6.
Profile owners apply one preset to every photo so that the grid has one tone.
